input_contract_from_paper.contour: 384x2 (x,y), min-max normalised per coordinate: subtract absolute minimum then divide by resulting absolute maximum
input_contract_from_paper.starting_point: leftmost (minimum-x) contour point first; ties resolved randomly (~3.5% neighbouring, ~0.3% further along)
input_contract_from_paper.image_route: KerNet2 takes a 40x40 binary image, avoiding the start-point problem
input_contract_from_paper.rotation: NOT globally invariant. Per-descriptor: Solidity is rotation-invariant, Major Axis Orientation is not. The paper reports per-descriptor sensitivity, not an aggregate accuracy drop.
input_contract_from_paper.mirror: never tested in the paper ('mirror' occurs 0 times)

S0-MDS-precomputed.what_it_is: Euclidean distance between the authors' own published official ShapeComp coordinates. Verified identical to the authors' published `dist` field (4.44e-16).
S0-MDS-precomputed.what_it_is_not: NOT a local execution of ShapeComp. Cannot score any new shape, because projecting a new shape requires the unobtainable descriptor engine or network weights.
S0-MDS-precomputed.consequence_for_retrieval: S0 can participate in the H1/H2 pairwise human-prediction experiment, but CANNOT participate in MPEG-7 Top-K retrieval, where no official coordinates exist.
